title: Apache PySpark using Python
overview: This course provides a deep dive into Apache PySpark, an open-source distributed computing framework for big data processing. Participants will learn how to use PySpark with Python to process, analyze, and transform large datasets efficiently. The course covers RDDs, DataFrames, Spark SQL, machine learning (MLlib), and performance optimizations, enabling participants to build scalable and high-performance data processing pipelines.
audience: Data Engineers who want to process large-scale data efficiently
Data Scientists working with big data and machine learning
Software Developers who need to integrate Spark into their applications
Cloud & DevOps Engineers working with distributed computing
Business Analysts dealing with massive datasets
AI & ML Practitioners leveraging PySpark for model training
methodology: Hands-on Coding Sessions – Writing and executing PySpark scripts
Live Demonstrations – Showcasing PySpark’s real-world applications
Real-World Use Cases – Applying PySpark in different business domains
Group Discussions & Q&A – Interactive knowledge-sharing sessions
Project-Based Learning – Final capstone project for practical implementation
competencies: Writing and Optimizing PySpark DataFrames & RDDs
Using Spark SQL for Large-Scale Data Analysis
Integrating PySpark with Cloud Storage & Databases
Machine Learning with MLlib in PySpark
Handling Streaming Data with Structured Streaming
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Understand Apache Spark’s architecture and execution model
Work with PySpark RDDs, DataFrames, and Spark SQL
Implement data transformations and aggregations efficiently
Optimize PySpark applications for performance and scalability
Develop machine learning models using Spark MLlib
Handle real-time data processing using Spark Streaming
Work with cloud-based and on-premises Spark clusters

items.text: Overview of Big Data and Distributed Computing
